newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 4.75/4.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 4.75/4.98 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $26.0 billion in three- and six-month bills is likely to produce average rates of 4.75 percent and 4.98 percent, respectively, traders said.

Good demand is expected. "There'll be good interest in the three-month bills specially because of the year-end buying and the fact that we have a lot of cash management bills maturing," said a trader at a major U.S. investment bank.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EST/1800 GMT.
In when-issued trade at around 1230 EST/1730 GMT, three-month bill rates were quoted at 4.76 percent while the six-month rates were at 4.98 percent.
